I have completed the independent review of the clinic appointments application without modifying any product files. The release verdict has been recorded in [REVIEW.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-xReJJE/workspace/REVIEW.md).

### Summary of What Was Verified:
1. **Source Code Audit:** Evaluated [src/server.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-xReJJE/workspace/src/server.js), [src/store.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-xReJJE/workspace/src/store.js), [public/index.html](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-xReJJE/workspace/public/index.html), and [package.json](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-xReJJE/workspace/package.json) against project specifications ([PRODUCT.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-xReJJE/workspace/PRODUCT.md), [ARCHITECTURE.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-xReJJE/workspace/ARCHITECTURE.md), [ux-walkthrough.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-xReJJE/workspace/ux-walkthrough.md), [design-direction.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-xReJJE/workspace/design-direction.md)).
2. **Security & Authorization Check:** Identified a critical missing ownership check in `GET /api/appointments/:id` and `POST /api/appointments/:id/notes`, allowing any signed-in patient to read or modify medical notes belonging to other patients.
3. **Frontend Completeness Check:** Confirmed that [public/index.html](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-xReJJE/workspace/public/index.html) lacks UI rendering code and scripts required by [ux-walkthrough.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-xReJJE/workspace/ux-walkthrough.md).
4. **Test Suite Verification:** Executed `npm test` (`node --test test/store.test.js`), which passes 1 basic store test but leaves API authorization un-tested.
5. **Product Acceptance Checker:** Ran `accept-check.js`, which returned a **BLOCK** verdict.
